title: Grateful Dead Live at Dupont Gymnasium, MIT on 1970-05-07
source: Source: Audience Cassette Master > Reel > PCM (Sony HG) - Provided by Tim Dalton; Transfer: PCM > Sony SL-10 > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 > WAV 16/44.1 - Transferred By Charlie Miller; New Riders Of The Purple Sage Source: Audience Cassette Master > ? > 7" Reel > DAT; Transfer: DAT > HD > SHN - Transferred by Noah Weiner; Lineage: wav > Adobe Audition 1.5 > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16; edited and mastered SIRMick February 2018; the original version of this source had a tracking error in the set 3 files

ai_review.summary: Rough recording quality but stellar performances of Easy Wind, The Other One/Cryptical and a monster Turn On Your Lovelight jam.
ai_review.review: The reviewer notes that the audio is rough and unrefined, yet the musical moments shine through – especially Easy Wind, the extended The Other One / Cryptical sequence and an expansive Turn On Your Lovelight jam that are described as “beyond category.” No specific source type is identified, and while the sound suffers, the show itself is praised for its improvisational gems.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review; it praises the musical performance strongly but flags poor recording quality, leading to a moderate overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes sound as rough and low‑fidelity, indicating significant audio issues despite the musical content.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Improvisational flow is highlighted, with extended jams praised; no comments on pacing problems.
